name: quantization_mxfp8_block
reference:
import torch

def run(x):
    x = x.float()
    scale = x.abs().amax().clamp_min(1e-6) / 127.0
    row_scale = x.abs().amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-6) / 127.0
    block_scale = x.reshape(x.shape[0], -1, 16).abs().amax(-1, keepdim=True).repeat_interleave(16, -1).reshape_as(x).clamp_min(1e-6) / 127.0
    return (torch.round(x / block_scale).clamp(-448, 448) * block_scale).to(torch.bfloat16)
